description: This file defines the ADODB2_mysql class, which extends ADODB_DataDict to provide MySQL-specific database schema management functions, including type mapping, index creation, and table alteration commands.

classes.name: ADODB2_mysql
classes.description: A class providing MySQL-specific database schema management functions, including type conversion and index handling.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps PHP data types and field properties to MySQL-specific type codes.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts internal type codes back to MySQL data types.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffix for column definitions based on attributes like unsigned, not null, default, auto-increment, and constraints.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Constructs SQL statements for creating, dropping, or replacing indexes on tables.
